title: Bạn có thể gửi tin nhắn văn bản cho tôi được không?
englishTitle: Can you send a text message for me?
pronunciation: Ban co the gui tin nhan van ban cho toi duoc khong
summary: For asking someone to send a short SMS when your phone setup is stuck.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: A local number, booking contact, driver, or hotel may need a text when your phone cannot send one.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the number and the message. Keep it short enough that the other person can check it before sending.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể gửi tin nhắn văn bản cho tôi được không?

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: The phrase asks for help sending a text message on your behalf; được không keeps it polite.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể gửi tin nhắn văn bản cho tôi được không?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi and SIM questions stay nearby if the message problem turns into a connection problem.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, SIM shops, tour counters, and cafe counters when a call is too much.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Do not hand over private codes; read one-time passwords yourself and keep sensitive messages visible to you.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: If the issue is battery, charger, or data, these phone lines cover the next practical fix.
